title: Joint conservativity of pro-etale restriction for condensed coefficient complexes
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $\{u_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a pro-etale covering family of $X$ in $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. With $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and $D(T,\Lambda)=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda_T)$ the ordinary unbounded derived category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $u_i^*=Lu_i^*:D(X,\Lambda)\to D(U_i,\Lambda)$ be the derived module inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] for the coefficient identification $\alpha_{u_i}:u_i^{-1}\Lambda_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_{U_i}$ of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]; under the identification $(U_i)_{\mathrm{proet}}\simeq X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U_i$ of [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization] and $u_i^{-1}G\cong G|_{U_i}$ of [lem-sfb-proetale-object-inverse-image-restriction] it is restriction $K\mapsto K|_{U_i}$. Then the functors $u_i^*$ are jointly conservative: a morphism in $D(X,\Lambda)$ is an isomorphism if and only if each $u_i^*$ carries it to an isomorphism. Equivalently, $K|_{U_i}=0$ for all $i$ implies $K=0$.

proof.text: For a cover member u, the published coefficient morphism alpha_u of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms] is an invertible monoid morphism. The source-library Mod.extendScalarsIsoComapInv, the comparison of [def-sfb-modobj-extension-along-iso], identifies extension along alpha_u with restriction along its inverse. Whisker this comparison first by mapMod(u inverse image) and then by Mod.forget. Restriction of scalars leaves the underlying sheaf unchanged, and mapMod commutes definitionally with forget. Thus the underlying abelian-sheaf functor of the actual condensed-module inverse image of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] is naturally the ordinary abelian inverse image. For a weakly etale u, the proved source-library upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction identifies that inverse image with localization restriction, by uniqueness of left adjoints. This uses no constant-ring comparison.

proof.text: Let a be a morphism of coefficient module objects whose pullbacks along all cover members are invertible. Forget the actions and use Step 1 to show that every localization restriction of its underlying abelian-sheaf map is invertible. Apply the already proved source-library isIso_of_isIso_localizationRestriction: it specializes the cover-local criterion [lem-sfb-sheaf-cover-local-isomorphism] using the base-changed covering sieves of the pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. These sieves are covering for arbitrary precoverage covers, including an empty cover when allowed. It follows that the underlying sheaf map is invertible. Mod.forget reflects isomorphisms: its inverse is automatically linear by cancelling the original invertible linear map. This gives the private proved helper isIso_of_condensed_cover.

proof.text: The coefficient inverse images are exact by the existing preservesFiniteLimits_upperStar and preservesFiniteColimits_upperStar instances. The proved source-library mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso supplies the natural comparison between applying inverse image to H^n and taking H^n after the termwise derived inverse image. It is the localization descent of the exact-functor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] through [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], already constructed in the adopted library; no new descent theorem is postulated. If all derived restrictions of f are invertible, naturality of this comparison makes every restriction of H^n(f) invertible. Apply the helper from Step 2 for each integer n, then DerivedCategory.isIso_iff of [lem-weil-pbc-unbounded-derived-iso-cohomology]. The reverse implication is preservation of isomorphisms by functors.

proof.text: For an object K whose derived restrictions are zero, consider the zero morphism K to the zero object. The exact termwise restriction is additive and hence preserves zero objects, so every restriction of this map is an isomorphism between zero objects. Step 3 implies that K to zero is invertible; transport IsZero along this isomorphism. All index universes are unchanged and no nonemptiness, finiteness, boundedness or quasi-compactness hypothesis is introduced.

lean.statement: theorem condensed_cover_restriction_conservative (Λ : Profinite.CondensedRing.{u}) [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{v} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X) : (∀ (K L : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X X))) (f : K ⟶ L), IsIso f ↔ ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, IsIso ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ.X (𝒰.f i)).mapDerivedCategory.map f)) ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X X)), (∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, IsZero ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ.X (𝒰.f i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) → IsZero K)
